subject: Florida, you’re up next — DashRite Advisory
body_initial:
Hi Eyal,

I’m writing to you as President/CEO (owner, Lalo family) at Invicta Watch Group. For an owner-led distribution business in Hollywood, the first look usually lands on the margin that hides between landed cost and the price list — inventory ordering, carrying cost and quote discipline.

Florida, you’re up next. We help owner-led businesses like Invicta Watch Group become more profitable and less chaotic — the brand and marketing that get you noticed, and the operations underneath that keep every promise once the phone rings. Built in the tools you already own, yours the day we leave.

First look is free: a findings review and a scoped number. Implementation is the paid engagement.

Worth 20 minutes?

Edward

—
Edward Edick
Managing Partner, Portfolio Operations · DashRite Advisory LLC
